sentences.text: Ankylosaurus was a quadrupedal dinosaur possessing a broad and robust body.
Its skull was wide and low, featuring two backward-pointing horns on the back of the head and two additional horns below them pointing backward and downward.
Unlike other ankylosaurs, the nostrils of this animal faced sideways instead of forward.
It had a beak at the front of its jaws and rows of small, leaf-shaped teeth further back.
The body was covered in armor plates, known as osteoderms, with bony half-rings on the neck and a large club at the end of its tail.
The genus was named by Barnum Brown in 1908.
The type specimen was discovered in 1906 by Barnum Brown in the Hell Creek Formation near Gilbert Creek, Montana.
In 1910, Barnum Brown's expedition found another specimen in the Scollard Formation near the Red Deer River in Alberta, Canada.
The broad muzzle suggests it was a non-selective browser.
Researchers believe the tail club was used for defense against predators or in fights with other Ankylosaurus.
It is possibly the largest known ankylosaurid, estimated at 6 to 8 meters long and weighing 4.8 to 8 metric tons.
The genus of this dinosaur is Ankylosaurus.
The only known species is Ankylosaurus magniventris.
Osborn coined the name Ankylosauria in 1923 to place ankylosaurids in their own suborder.
Ankylosauria and Stegosauria are grouped together within the clade Thyreophora.
Ankylosaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous Period, approximately 70 to 66 million years ago.
Fossils of Ankylosaurus have been found in western North America.
Fossils have been found in the Hell Creek, Lance, Scollard, Frenchman, and Ferris formations.
It is hypothesized that Ankylosaurus may have inhabited upland areas.
The presence of fleshy cheeks in ornithischians is controversial, though some related nodosaurs had armor plates covering the cheek region.
Carpenter suggested that Ankylosaurus neck armor formed an inverted V-shape with a midline gap filled by small ossicles to allow movement.
Arbour and Currie disagreed with Carpenter's 2015 interpretation, noting that the holotype fragments did not fit as Carpenter proposed.
Arbour and Currie suggested that Ankylosaurus neck armor consisted of two semi-circular plates around the upper neck, similar to Anodontosaurus and Euoplocephalus.
